home_intro: A community centred on Jesus, growing in faith and sharing life together in the heart of Bagshot.
welcome_title:
There’s a place
for you here.
welcome_body: New Life Church is a church family being established in the heart of Bagshot. We’re people of different ages and backgrounds, learning to follow Jesus and to love our neighbours well.
welcome_extra: As we prepare for this new chapter, we’d love to meet you. Whether church is familiar to you or completely new, you’re welcome to connect with us.
vision_title:
To see Bagshot
transformed through
the Gospel.
